CustomField.description: In Business Hours, Created Date/Time to Lead Owner Assigned Timestamp
CustomField.formula:
IF ( ISBLANK(Lead_Owner_Changed_Timestamp__c)=FALSE ,
ROUND( 8 * ( ( 5 * FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE( Lead_Owner_Changed_Timestamp__c ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7) + MIN(5, MOD( DATEVALUE( Lead_Owner_Changed_Timestamp__c ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8), 7) + MIN( 1, 24 / 8 * ( MOD( Lead_Owner_Changed_Timestamp__c - DATETIMEVALUE( '1900-01-08 16:00:00' ), 1 ) ) ) ) ) - ( 5 * FLOOR( ( DATEVALUE( OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c ) - DATE( 1900, 1, 8) ) / 7) + MIN( 5, MOD( DATEVALUE( OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c ) - DATE( 1996, 1, 1), 7 ) + MIN( 1, 24 / 8 * ( MOD( OR_Created_Date_n_Time__c - DATETIMEVALUE( '1900-01-08 16:00:00' ), 1) ) ) ) ) ), 0 ) ,0)
CustomField.inlineHelpText: In Business Hours, Created Date/Time to Lead Owner Assigned Timestamp
CustomField.label: Business Hours to Assign Owner
